phases.name: Project discovery
phases.summary: RO-001 recorded the repository. RO-012 adds the project-control registries and is in review.

phases.name: Original game research
phases.summary: No authorized original specification is in the repository. RO-013 is ready. Client and gameplay research stay backlog.

phases.name: Architecture
phases.summary: RO-002 recorded the database architecture. ADR-0001 through ADR-0004 remain the accepted server decisions.

phases.name: Database foundation
phases.summary: Models, migration 93510e8bf194, imports, and database QA are recorded. RO-009 is ready and RO-011 is blocked on that review.

phases.name: Core game services
phases.summary: Schemas and the service foundation are recorded. Logout, progression rewards, and lobby gaps are backlog until RO-011.

phases.name: Gameplay engine
phases.summary: The deterministic simulator is recorded in RO-022. Movement, combat, and results evidence tasks are backlog. Original combat values are unknown.

phases.name: Networking and client compatibility
phases.summary: The matrix, protocol validator, and RO-028 review are recorded. 43 features remain unknown against original RoS. No official client protocol is implemented.

phases.name: Quality and performance
phases.summary: The test runner, function tracker, Locust sample, monitoring docs, and regression reports are recorded. Those results do not prove original compatibility.

phases.name: Release and deployment
phases.summary: Database operations are documented. Release readiness stays backlog until RO-011. Compose was not started.
